prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a THREE-FRAME limited-animation key-pose SPRITE SHEET of this exact Song dynasty father and his little daughter standing side by side on a field road looking at the fields, both turned toward the LEFT of the image in three-quarter view. TWO reference images. The FIRST shows the exact two people to draw: copy identity, face, hair, clothing colours and carried objects from it. Its camera angle is from slightly above and partly from behind; IGNORE that angle. The SECOND reference is a finished three-cell sheet of a different person: copy ONLY its camera angle (eye-level three-quarter view, the same as every other figure on the street), its figure scale and its three-cell layout. Do NOT copy that person. Keep their identity: the father has a dark blue cap, a dark blue long robe with a brown sash and cream trousers; the girl has a long black braid, an ochre-yellow jacket with a brown sash and cream trousers. They stand close together, the girl on the right, slightly in front of his hip. Cell 1 (left) = rest: both stand still, the father's arms relaxed at his sides, the girl looking up at him. Cell 2 (middle) = pointing: the father raises his right arm and points far off to the upper left, turning his head that way; the girl follows his arm and looks toward the left. Cell 3 (right) = explaining: the father lowers his arm to chest height and bends slightly toward the girl, speaking to her with an open palm; the girl looks up at him and lifts one hand, asking a question. The feet stay planted on exactly the same spot in all three cells; only the arms, hands, heads and upper bodies move, with believable weight at the hips and knees. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the first reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 3 equal-width cells, one full group per cell, centered in its cell with generous margin so hands, baskets, scrolls, sleeves and feet never touch a cell edge. Identical character size and identical camera angle in every cell. Redraw at higher detail than the small reference without changing the design. Make every cell match the first reference and match each other as strictly as possible.
